original_findings_reevaluated.title: E2E test project excluded from solution — Playwright/NUnit tests never run in CI
original_findings_reevaluated.resolution: ContestJudging.E2ETests.csproj added to ContestJudging.slnx:11. dotnet test ContestJudging.slnx now exercises all three test projects including E2E.

original_findings_reevaluated.title: No code coverage collected in CI despite coverlet.collector being configured
original_findings_reevaluated.note: --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" flag still missing from dotnet test command.

original_findings_reevaluated.title: Six of seven GitHub Actions use floating major-version tags (supply chain risk)
original_findings_reevaluated.resolution: All action versions updated to valid 2026 releases (checkout@v6 v6.0.2, setup-dotnet@v5 v5.2.0, cache@v5 v5.0.5, configure-pages@v6 v6.0.0, deploy-pages@v5 v5.0.0). Original defect was non-existent version tags; all now resolve. Floating-tag pattern remains (GitHub-recommended practice).

original_findings_reevaluated.title: No SAST or CodeQL scanning — only dependency scanning is present
original_findings_reevaluated.resolution: codeql-analysis job added at pipeline.yml:48-73 with github/codeql-action/init@v3 + analyze@v3, csharp language matrix, and security-events write permission.

original_findings_reevaluated.title: release/ directory (published Blazor WASM output) is committed to the repository
original_findings_reevaluated.resolution: release/ no longer tracked by git. .gitignore [Rr]elease/ pattern on line 25 case-insensitively matches release/. Directory still exists on disk from prior local builds but is gitignored.

original_findings_reevaluated.title: No Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates
No CODEOWNERS file for automated PR review assignment
No PR template or issue templates
dotnet-tools.json manifest has no tools configured
original_findings_reevaluated.note: dotnet-tools.json still contains "tools": {}. No action needed until additional CLI tools are required.

original_findings_reevaluated.title: Deploy job redundantly rebuilds from source instead of reusing tested artifacts
original_findings_reevaluated.note: Deploy job still calls dotnet publish independently instead of using actions/upload-artifact + actions/download-artifact.

new_findings.title: E2E test reliability — no explicit Playwright browser installation in CI
new_findings.rule_violated: CI completeness — E2E browser tests need browser binaries
new_findings.remediation: Add explicit pwsh bin/Debug/net10.0/playwright.ps1 install --with-deps chromium step before dotnet test, or verify Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit MSBuild targets handle install on ubuntu-latest.

new_findings.title: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 is outdated — latest is v5
new_findings.rule_violated: Action freshness — v3 bundles @actions/artifact pre-punycode-fix and pre-Node24

new_findings.title: CodeQL Action v3 scheduled for deprecation in December 2026
new_findings.rule_violated: Action lifecycle — v3 logs deprecation warning; v4 is current

triggers.assessment: adequate — covers default branch only, no tag triggers
